text: Unlike Swift-9, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Curlew-3 is 950 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Curlew-3 applies to Swift-9, the rate limit differs. An older draft of this note was archived.

Unlike Bittern-5, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Dunlin-5 is Priya Quintero. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Dunlin-5 applies to Bittern-5, the pager rotation differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Kestrel-8, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Curlew-3 is the Sprocket team. Nobody should assume the owner of Curlew-3 applies to Kestrel-8, the owner differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Unlike Siskin-6, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Dunlin-5 is $4195k. Nobody should assume the budget of Dunlin-5 applies to Siskin-6, the budget differs.

Unlike Bittern-5, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Dunlin-5 is March 11, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Dunlin-5 applies to Bittern-5, the retirement date differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Unlike Swift-9, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Bittern-5 is $70k. Nobody should assume the budget of Bittern-5 applies to Swift-9, the budget differs.
Unlike Bittern-5, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Kestrel-8 is the Tessera team. Nobody should assume the owner of Kestrel-8 applies to Bittern-5, the owner differs.

Questions about Bittern-5 start with its owner, the Tessera team; they triage anything filed against it. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Questions about Siskin-6 start with its owner, the Harbor team; they triage anything filed against it. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Curlew-3 runs in the Nairobi datacenter, next to its database. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Pages from Curlew-3 land on the pager rotation of Vera Jaramillo before anyone else.

Unlike Swift-9, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Dunlin-5 is Haskell. Nobody should assume the language of Dunlin-5 applies to Swift-9, the language differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Swift-9, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Kestrel-8 is the Oslo datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Kestrel-8 applies to Swift-9, the datacenter differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Celia Abernathy is on the pager rotation of Kestrel-8 this month, with a deputy as backup. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
The language of Bittern-5 is Zig, which new contributors must know.
Siskin-6 is implemented in OCaml; the language was chosen for its tooling.
The pager rotation for Bittern-5 is run by Bruno Fairbanks; alerts page them first.
